title: College Lecture Series - Neil Postman - "The Surrender of Culture to Technology"
summary: Neil Postman's 1997 lecture at College of DuPage, based on his book, argues that Americans treat technology as a national religion and depend on it to solve larger human problems. It includes audience questions.
why: HN recommends it to engineers as a skeptical counterweight to technology boosterism, especially for those building AI and consumer tech features.

quote.text: I suggest the people working on those features watch Neil Postman's "The Surrender of Culture to Technology"
